mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant renal potassium wasting and nephrotoxicity, leading to severe hypokalemia that is further exacerbated by concurrent potassium supplementation requirements.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels closely; use potassium supplementation cautiously and only when levels are documented as low; consider amphotericin B formulations with lower nephrotoxicity (liposomal) and aggressive renal function monitoring.
